what: Improvements, each with the problem, the options, the cost, the risk, and what I recommend. Nothing here is implemented; the decision is yours.

suggestions.title: Make the market prior real: buy one closing-line history, or retire the edge language
suggestions.problem: Every 'edge' number is currently the model compared with itself. There is no price in the repository.

options.label: License a closing-line feed and backfill one season
options.risk: terms may forbid republication of the line itself

options.label: Ship model numbers only, and delete the word 'edge' from the site
options.risk: the brief's core ask goes unmet

options.label: Record lines manually, one screenshot per slate, with a timestamp
options.risk: unlicensed, unverifiable at scale, and a human step you said you do not want

suggestions.recommend: B now, A when a licence exists — because B is honest and costs nothing, and A is the only path to a measured edge.

suggestions.title: Settle every game day automatically, or the ledger rots
suggestions.problem: 8 of 9 games from 11/15 have no verified final in the repository, and one pick is stranded open.

options.label: Fetch two official reads per finished game in the refresh job
options.risk: game books post minutes after the final; a run at 23:15 UTC will miss late West-Coast games, so the next run must retry

options.label: Settle from the schedule page's printed finals only
options.risk: one read is not verification, and the page can carry a live score that later changes

suggestions.recommend: A, with the retry obvious: the outstanding list is already published so a miss is visible rather than silent.

suggestions.title: Close the projection/bet navigation hole
suggestions.problem: The two surfaces are built and separated correctly, but nothing on the front door links to them.

options.label: Add one 'Surfaces' nav group linking projection/ and bet/
options.risk: another session owns that file; must be merged, not duplicated

options.label: Link them from this session's review page and leave the canonical nav alone
options.risk: a reader still has to find the review page first

suggestions.recommend: A at the next integration, B today.

suggestions.title: Publish the disagreement as a distribution, not one number
suggestions.problem: The headline is a single disagreement figure per game. A reader cannot tell a stable disagreement from one flipping between sides run to run.

options.label: Show the disagreement's moving-average and its change since the previous capture
options.risk: more columns on an already wide table

options.label: Keep one number
options.risk: the confidence signal is less informative than it claims

suggestions.recommend: A, but only after two consecutive captures exist to diff.

suggestions.title: Add a settlement SPAN to the picks table
suggestions.problem: A settled pick shows WIN, but not how the win relates to the model's own confidence or the margin.

options.label: Add 'final margin vs pick line' next to the outcome
Leave it
options.risk: a WIN by 1 point and a WIN by 30 look identical

suggestions.title: Give the injury archive a retention and backfill rule
suggestions.problem: 3 of the 76 filings the official index lists for 11/15 are archived. The diff between consecutive reports is the feature; with three files it can only fire twice.

options.label: Backfill the day's filings once, then append on every refresh
options.risk: PDF text extraction is imperfect; unattributed rows must keep being published as such

options.label: Append only, going forward
options.risk: the first day with a real status change is when the archive starts

suggestions.recommend: A for 11/15 only, so the diff has material, then B.
